title: Insert Interval
statement:
Given a list of non-overlapping intervals sorted by their start time, and a new interval to insert, merge the new interval with any overlapping intervals in the list. Return a new list of intervals in sorted order with no overlaps.

An interval is represented as [start, end] where start and end are inclusive integers.

visibleExamples.explanation: The new interval [2, 7] overlaps with [1, 5], so they merge to [1, 7].
The new interval [4, 8] overlaps with [3, 5] and [6, 9], merging all three into [3, 9].
The new interval [6, 8] does not overlap with [1, 5], so both intervals are kept separate.
